gloss.en: Smart glasses use wearable AI to help writers capture real-world inspirations for fiction, blending augmented reality with creative flow.
gloss.zh: 智能眼镜通过可穿戴AI帮助作家捕捉现实世界的灵感，融合增强现实与创作流。

why_now.en: You study human computer interaction and embodied cognition: this wearable AI system bridges physical experience and digital creation.
why_now.zh: 你研究人机交互与具身认知：该可穿戴系统连接物理体验与数字创作。

gloss.en: Augmented reality is being reimagined to help Deaf students in experiential learning by reducing split attention between task and interpreter.
gloss.zh: 增强现实被重新构想，帮助听障学生减少在任务与翻译间分散注意力。

why_now.en: You follow human computer interaction and embodied cognition: this shows how AR can address embodied challenges in learning for diverse users.
why_now.zh: 你关注人机交互与具身认知：这展示了AR如何解决不同用户在学习中的具身挑战。
